s: They're by far the best grips I've tried. Very comfortable and soft but durable and just right size. I've tried some of the more popular brands such as ESI but these are better IMO. They're also quite cheap, around 10€ I believe. ... Turns out I was able to find them at a local Pivot dealer.

t: All new Pivot Phoenix Factory Lock-On ergo grips are worthy of any mountain bike - Bikerumor
s: February 4, 2020 - Going along with the new shape and construction, the grips feature a raised micro-grid texture with low durometer ultra-tacky rubber for a supremely comfortable feel at the bar. Somehow, the texture and the rubber makes them feel both squishy and firm at the same time. Hopefully the durability matches up to their feel. Offered in six colors, it’s probably not a coincidence that they match up quite well with a bowl of M&Ms. But they should also match well with a number of current bikes – Pivot or otherwise.
